item.title: Spain deploys military to Ceuta after thousands of people breach Morocco's border
item.description: Spain will deploy its military to restore order at its border with Morocco in Ceuta after thousands of migrants streamed into the tiny Spanish territory, with at least nine dying in the attempt.

item.title: Trump announces a deal for Hamas to disarm, but many hurdles and uncertainty remain
item.description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its forces from Gaza. But many hurdles, conditions and long timelines remain to wind down the war in the Palestinian territory.

item.title: The Trump administration wants $10 million more to cover its July Fourth celebrations
item.description: Congress allocated $150 million for 250th birthday events. The Trump-backed group that planned the state fair and July 4th fireworks is asking for an additional $10 million in reimbursements.

item.title: Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you
item.description: Solo living, solo travel, and solo dining are all being embraced as more adults are choosing to remain single. Many Americans aren't interested in dating, and being single is a symbol of autonomy.

item.title: European soccer leaders to boycott the World Cup in an unprecedented step
item.description: European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

item.title: The economy slowed a bit -- but Americans continued to spend
item.description: The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, according to the Commerce Department. That's a modest slowdown from the previous quarter — but consumer spending picked up steam.
item.content:encoded:
